terminals.name: makropanel
terminals.command: source "$HOME/.venv/bin/activate" && export PANEL_BRAND=makro SERVICE_MODE=panel ADMIN_USERNAME=tolgakt ADMIN_PASSWORD=makro123 PORT=8080 && exec gunicorn app:app --bind 0.0.0.0:8080 --workers 1 --threads 4 --worker-class gthread --timeout 120 --keep-alive 5

terminals.name: mikromail
terminals.command: source "$HOME/.venv/bin/activate" && export SERVICE_MODE=mailing PANEL_BRAND=makro MAILING_WORKER_EXTERNAL=1 MAILING_SUPERADMIN_USER=tolgakt MAILING_SUPERADMIN_PASSWORD=makro123 ADMIN_USERNAME=tolgakt ADMIN_PASSWORD=makro123 PORT=8081 && exec gunicorn mailing_app:app --bind 0.0.0.0:8081 --workers 1 --threads 4 --worker-class gthread --timeout 7200 --keep-alive 5

terminals.name: mikromail-worker
terminals.command: source "$HOME/.venv/bin/activate" && export SERVICE_MODE=mailing-worker MAILING_WORKER_EXTERNAL=1 && exec python mailing_worker_main.py
